('Poker Chip Sticker', 'Die-cut vinyl sticker of the F2D poker chip. For those who gamble with fate.', '/images/products/chip-sticker.png', 1, NOW(), NOW()),
('Bee Head Sticker', 'Die-cut vinyl sticker of the biker bee mascot. The face of the hive.', '/images/products/bee-head-sticker.png', 1, NOW(), NOW()),
('F2D Sticker Pack', 'Complete set of all 5 Flesh to Death stickers. Save $10 when you buy the pack.', '/images/products/sticker-pack.png', 1, NOW(), NOW()),
('Skull Wrench Patch', 'Embroidered iron-on patch featuring the skull with wrench. 3.5" diameter.', '/images/products/skull-patch.png', 1, NOW(), NOW()),
('F2D Circle Badge Patch', 'Embroidered iron-on patch of the classic circle badge logo. 4" diameter.', '/images/products/badge-patch.png', 1, NOW(), NOW());
